1000003.name: Iron Body
1000003.desc: Boosts DEF and Max HP by a set percentage, and decreases damage taken when hit by enemies.

1000009.name: Warrior Mastery
1000009.desc: Trains up your warrior basics to increase Movement Speed, Jump, Max HP, and Max Movement Speed. Also grants a chance to resist knockback.

1001005.name: Slash Blast
1001005.desc: Consumes MP to attack nearby enemies all at once.

1001008.name: War Leap
1001008.desc: Use while in the middle of a jump to jump even farther. The higher the skill level, the farther the jump.

1100000.name: Weapon Mastery
1100000.desc: Increase Sword and Axe Mastery and Attack Speed.\n#cLevel 10 required to learn Advanced Combo Attack.#

1100009.name: Physical Training
1100009.desc: Permanently increases STR and DEX through sheer physical training.

1101006.name: Spirit Blade
1101006.desc: The sword and the spirit are united to improve the Attack Power of party members including yourself for a short time, and reflect a multiple of the damage that you receive.

1101011.name: Brandish
1101011.desc: #c[Swordsmanship]# Perform a double attack on enemies in front of you.

1110000.name: Self Recovery
1110000.desc: Regularly recovers some HP and MP, even in combat.

1111010.name: Intrepid Slash
1111010.desc: #c[Swordsmanship]# Deal 3 consecutive attacks to multiple enemies in front of you.

2001002.name: Magic Guard
2001002.desc: A portion of the damage dealt to you affects your MP instead of your HP. Does not apply to attacks that inflict damage in proportion to your Max HP.\nActivated automatically when you have at least 1 MP, and is ineffective when you have 0 MP. Can be toggled #cOn/Off# with the skill key.

2001003.name: Magic Armor
2001003.desc: Uses magic to temporarily increase DEF. \nRequired Skill: \n#cMagic Guard Lv. 3#

2001004.name: Energy Bolt
2001004.desc: Consumes MP to attack one enemy.

2001005.name: Magic Claw
2001005.desc: Attack nearby enemies continuously by consuming MP.\nRequired Skill: #cEnergy Bolt Lv. 1#

2101001.name: Meditation
2101001.desc: Temporarily enhance the Magic Attack of all party members nearby through meditation.\nRequired Skill: #cMP Eater Lv. 3#

2101002.name: Teleport
2101002.desc: Allows you to teleport to other locations on the same map using the arrow keys.\n#cLevel 5 required to learn Teleport Mastery.#

2101004.name: Flame Orb
2101004.desc: A fire-attribute attack. Creates and throws a burning orb at multiple enemies.

2101005.name: Poison Breath
2101005.desc: Conjures a poison-attribute cloud, inflicting fatal damage to enemies. The enemies will take additional periodic damage for a short time.

2301001.name: Teleport
2301001.desc: Allows you to teleport to other locations on the same map using the arrow keys.\n#cLevel 5 required to learn Teleport Mastery.#

2301003.name: Invincible
2301003.desc: Temporarily decreases all damage received. \nRequired Skill: #cHeal Lv. 5#

2301004.name: Bless
2301004.desc: Increases Attack Power, Magic ATT, and DEF for you and all nearby party members for a short time. Can be stacked with other buff skills.\nRequired Skill: #cInvincible Lv. 5#\n#cLevel 10 required to learn Advanced Blessing.#

2301005.name: Holy Arrow
2301005.desc: Attacks multiple monsters with Holy Arrows.  Very effective against Undead and Devil monsters.

2301008.name: Magic Booster
2301008.desc: Increases Magic Attack Speed for a short time.

2301010.name: Angelic Wrath
2301010.desc: #c[Vengeance]# Calls down an avenging angel to strike the enemy. Enemies struck will be weakened and their Defense will be reduced for a short time.

3001004.name: Arrow Blow
3001004.desc: Shoot consecutive arrows at multiple enemies.

3001005.name: Double Shot
3001005.desc: Fires two arrows at an enemy.

3001007.name: Double Jump
3001007.desc: Allows you to use the Double Jump skill to move #cvery quickly.# Double-tap the up arrow key to jump again while in mid-air. Double-tap the down arrow key to descend more quickly. If you use Action Customization, you can move up in the air with the up arrow and jump keys, and descend with the down arrow and jump keys.\n#cRight-click to toggle Action Customization ON/OFF.#

3101003.name: Double Jump
3101003.desc: Leap once more while already in the air.

3101004.name: Soul Arrow: Bow
3101004.desc: Increases Attack Power and allows you to use Bows without arrows for a short time.

3101005.name: Wind Arrow
3101005.desc: Fire multiple arrows that fly like the wind.

3101007.name: Silver Hawk
3101007.desc: Summons a silver hawk that hovers around you, attacking and possibly Stunning monsters nearby.

3101008.name: Covering Fire
3101008.desc: Fire arrows while leaping backwards. While firing, you'll have 100% Knockback Resistance. If you press and hold the skill key, you will fire arrows rapidly while in mid-air. You will temporarily not be pushed back by any attack after casting.

3101009.name: Quiver Cartridge
3101009.desc: Use a special arrowhead. Learning #cEnchanted Quiver# adds arrowheads you can use. Arrowheads can be changed by using the skill again.

4001002.name: Disorder
4001002.desc: Temporarily decreases an enemy's Weapon Attack and Defense, eventually neutralizing the monster's attack. Cannot be used on the same monster repeatedly.

4001003.name: Dark Sight
4001003.desc: Allows you to hide in the shadows for a short time to avoid the enemy's attack. While Dark Sight is active, you can deactivate it either by using another skill or by pressing the Dark Sight skill key again. Note that certain movement skills will not cancel Dark Sight. Upon deactivating Dark Sight, its cooldown will vary according to damage dodged in proportion to your to Max HP.

4001005.name: Haste
4001005.desc: Temporarily increases Speed and Jump for all party members. Permanently increases maximum Speed.

4001011.name: Flash Jump
4001011.desc: Use while in the middle of a jump to jump twice in a row. The jump distance increases as the skill level increases. Can also be used with the Jump Key.

4101003.name: Claw Booster
4101003.desc: Uses MP to temporarily increase the attack speed of your Claw by 2 levels. Required Skill: #cClaw Mastery Lv. 5#

4101004.name: Haste
4101004.desc: Temporarily boosts Speed and Jump of the entire team.

4101005.name: Drain
4101005.desc: Absorb some of the damage dished out to the enemy as HP. You cannot absorb more than half of your Max HP or more than the enemy's Max HP.

4101008.name: Shuriken Burst
4101008.desc: Throws an exploding shuriken to damage the target and nearby enemies.

4101009.name: Flash Jump
4101009.desc: Use in mid-jump to jump even further. The jumping distance increases as the skill level increases.

4111005.name: Avenger
4111005.desc: Throws a throwing star. The throwing star will go through an enemy and attack the ones behind it, too.

4111010.name: Triple Throw
4111010.desc: Throw 3 throwing stars simultaneously. Throwing stars target the enemy with the highest HP first.

0001000.name: Three Snails
0001000.desc: [Master Level : 3]\nHurls snail shells to attack monsters from long distance.

0001001.name: Recovery
0001001.desc: [Master Level: 3]\nAllows you to steadily recover HP for 30 sec. \n#cCooldown: 2 min#

0001002.name: Nimble Feet
0001002.desc: [Master Level: 3]\nTemporarily enables the user to move around quickly. \n#cCooldown: 1 min#
